all_gausses.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_gausses

strip_sources_majax_ge_20.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where majax >= 20 and ra >= 10 and ra < 11

strip_gausses.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_gausses where ra >= 10 and ra < 11

strip_component_rows.query: select source_name, count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_gausses where ra >= 10 and ra < 11 group by source_name

strip_sources.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where ra >= 10 and ra < 11

strip_sources_code_s.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where s_code = 'S' and ra >= 10 and ra < 11

strip_sources_code_m.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where s_code = 'M' and ra >= 10 and ra < 11

strip_sources_code_c.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where s_code = 'C' and ra >= 10 and ra < 11

all_sources_code_m.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where s_code = 'M'

all_sources_code_m_majax_ge_20.query: select count(*) as n from lotss_dr3.main_sources where s_code = 'M' and majax >= 20
